posts.post_caption:
100% open-source toolkit to work with LLMs!

👉Train, fine-tune or chat on your machine

Transformer Lab is an app that allows anyone to experiment with LLMs.

Here's what you can do with it:

- One-click download of 100s of popular models—DeepSeek, Llama3, Gemma, etc.
- Finetune or train across different Hardware (Apple Silicon, GPU, etc.)
- RLHF and Preference Optimization are available.
- Chat with models—chat, completion, tool use, template prompts, etc.
- Use several inference engines like vLLM, Llama CPP
- Drag and drop file UI for RAG.
- Pull from 1000s of datasets available on HuggingFace.
- Log all inference requests.

Everything within a single interface ✨.

You can run the user interface on your desktop/laptop while the engine runs on a remote or cloud machine. Or you can run everything locally as well.

We have linked the GitHub repo in the comments.
